about: Routes that could cut the memory BioCLIP 2's shipped device file (pub/model-bioclip2-l14 at 462ecdc, hybrid-fc2-w8) needs in onnxruntime-web 1.30.0's WASM build, each in a fresh Node process on the same 24 test photos as run/lab/mem-base: (a) the graph in ORT format (saved by onnxruntime at the basic level), with the runtime's default use_ort_model_bytes_directly, with use_ort_model_bytes_for_initializers, and with bytes copied; (b) the weights in an external data file handed to the runtime beside a small graph, also letting go of the bytes and with lean allocation; (d) graphOptimizationLevel basic and disabled, enableCpuMemArena and enableMemPattern off; (e) use_device_allocator_for_initializers and disable_prepacking. The job with the external data routes also runs the page's own worker (vendor/rec-worker.js) in headless Chromium with the shipped file and reads the renderer's memory with ps.
